name: marker-length
description: Marker laser length under the crosshair. A connected 10-block volume line shows a white '10 blocks' label; stone in the sight line hides it, leaves do not; two unconnected markers 7 apart show a grey '7 blocks' only while a Marker Wrench is held. The rig is cleared at the end so other marker scenarios start clean.

steps.label: platform, a line pair and a preview pair
right-click a marker to connect the line

steps.name: connected
steps.look: red laser along X; white '10 blocks' just below the crosshair

steps.name: behind-stone
steps.look: stone block under the crosshair; NO length label

steps.name: behind-leaves
steps.look: leaves under the crosshair; the '10 blocks' label still shows

steps.name: preview-empty-hand
steps.look: two markers, no preview line between them; the label (if any) is the connected line further back, through the leaves: 10 blocks

steps.name: preview-marker-wrench
steps.look: faint preview line between the markers; grey '7 blocks' below the crosshair
